Collecting hoopers: 2045/3000 (Source: @nbahighlightreel) - Follow: @hoopfarmer for more content like this I’ll focus on Trae Young’s next chapter in Washington, his elite playmaking, and his opportunity to help lead the Wizards into a new era. Trae Young is entering a new chapter in Washington, and he has the opportunity to completely change the future of the Wizards. After spending more than seven seasons as the face of the Atlanta Hawks, Trae was traded to Washington in January 2026. The four-time All-Star then committed to the Wizards long-term, signing a four-year, $212 million contract this offseason. Although injuries limited him to just 15 games last season, Trae remains one of the NBA’s most gifted offensive playmakers, with career averages of 25.1 points and 9.8 assists per game. What makes Trae so dangerous is his ability to control an entire offense. His deep three-point range forces defenders to pick him up well beyond the arc, while his handle, floater and pick-and-roll mastery allow him to create scoring opportunities for himself and his teammates. He can punish defenses with his scoring or find open teammates with passes that most players wouldn’t even attempt. Now Trae has a new supporting cast featuring Anthony Davis, No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa and promising young talents like Alex Sarr and Tre Johnson. The combination of Trae’s elite playmaking, Davis’ two-way dominance and Dybantsa’s scoring potential gives Washington a foundation it hasn’t had in years. The biggest challenge will be staying healthy and turning that talent into consistent winning basketball. Trae has already taken Atlanta to the Eastern Conference Finals. Now he gets the chance to build something special in Washington and prove he can lead another franchise back into contention. #TraeYoung #WashingtonWizards #NBA #Wizards
